policy: Deterministic public-CI security gates. No hidden SaaS correctness dependency. Findings fail visibly unless explicitly allowlisted with rationale, expiry, and owner.

secret_scan.scope: repository-owned tracked files; donor, provenance, evidence, and lockfile paths excluded by explicit policy
secret_scan.gate: fail on any non-allowlisted credential-like match

donor_publish_guard.gate: fail when Gomrey release automation targets donor-owned repositories, buckets, or image namespaces

lockfile_pin.gate: fail when a shipped JS/TS surface lacks package-lock.json or the Python surface lacks uv.lock, or when uv sync --locked is not enforced in CI

dependency_vulnerability.js_tool: npm audit --audit-level=high --json (per surface: root, electron, servers/nextjs)

severity_policy.critical: fail unless the exact advisory is allowlisted with rationale and unexpired review date
severity_policy.high: fail unless the exact advisory is allowlisted with rationale and unexpired review date
severity_policy.moderate: reported; must be triaged before P15 hardening

dependency_vulnerability.allowlist_process: Additions require advisory URL/ID, affected surface, rationale (why immediate upgrade is unsafe or inapplicable), expiry date no more than 180 days out, and owner. Expired or stale entries fail the gate. P15 tightens moderate handling and re-evaluates every high/critical.
